status: Evidence acquisition plan; no owner request sent and no disassembly authorized
priority_basis: Engineering consequence, not easiest acquisition; start low-burden owner photo bundle for priorities3/4 in parallel with spare-part evidence1/2.
owner_minimum_bundle: One wide pump/heater-tube context view plus accessible front/side close views with common landmarks
One ACT location view and accessible connector/tag close-up
Any existing oil-pump/rod-bolt/water-pump replacement receipts or part labels; none required if unavailable
capture_rules: Do not dismantle or unplug the truck for this plan; only accessible views with engine off and cool.
Use the same specimen in all views; record part number, revision, donor year/engine and replacement status.
Keep camera square to measured face; place scale in that face plane; include one wide orientation view.
Record measurements inmm with instrument type/resolution and repeated values; distinguish measured, photo-estimated and inaccessible.
No geometric tolerance is inferred from camera pixel agreement or caliper display resolution.

priorities.impact: Unlock correct pump mounting, pickup joint and pressure outlet; current physical decomposition is wrong.
owner_no_disassembly: Only any already available service receipts or part labels; installed exterior photos cannot expose this internal joint.
bench_required: Applicable spare pump with pickup flange exposed: square-on mounting face and two perpendicular side views; retain drive axis and front orientation.
Measure drive-axis-to-mount-face distance; face outline; bolt/dowel/outlet center coordinates from drive axis; port diameters; gasket thickness/openings.
Separate pickup flange: inlet diameter, bolt centers/thread and stack thickness, tube departure direction.
Matching donor block mounting seat/gallery entry, tied to crank axis and front block face; passage identity must be directly established.
priorities.datum: Pump drive axis is primary; mounting face is axial zero; signed front direction fixes clocking. Matching block datum ties to crank axis/front face.
priorities.uncertainty: Existing drive lean and block feet are estimates. A pump alone cannot establish block outlet routing. Record tool resolution, repeat measurements and inaccessible features; photos cannot establish hidden passage shape.
alternatives: Dimensioned manufacturer drawing for identified C5AZ6600A/M74 production revision
Identified spare/donor pump plus matching block; qualified shop survey
priorities.exact_fidelity_user_dependency: Exact installed revision needs owner records/identification or an identified specimen from this truck. A donor/replacement can support only that specimen until equivalence is established.

priorities.impact: Resolve six frozen rod-bolt/block motion failures without clearance-driven geometry changes.
owner_no_disassembly: Existing rebuild receipts, rod/bolt kit part numbers or prior teardown images if already available; no request to open the engine.
bench_required: Applicable spare rod/cap/bolt assembly: head plan and two elevations with scale; mark engine-front and numbered/cam side.
Measure head outline/height/clocking, under-head radius and seat plane relative to split; both bolt axes relative to big-end bore.
Measure press shoulder/grip/thread extents and matching rod/cap bores; preserve paired parts. Bolt extraction/reinstallation belongs to a qualified spare-part survey, not an owner photo task.
Donor block inner surface around frozen witness tied to crank axis/cylinder station to distinguish bolt error from estimated crankcase cavity.
priorities.datum: Big-end bore center/axis, rod split plane, small-end axis and front/cam-side orientation.
priorities.uncertainty: OEM versus ARP replacement cannot be mixed. Existing current head direction is source-supported; plan outline, seating dimensions and block cavity are not.
alternatives: ARP152-6002 dimensional drawing plus applicable rod-seat survey
Machine-shop donor rod and block section measurements
priorities.exact_fidelity_user_dependency: Actual internal fastener identity cannot be known from an exterior owner photo. Original-truck fidelity requires trustworthy rebuild history or inspection during separately planned service; replacement study can proceed from an identified spare.

priorities.impact: Resolve source-estimated tube route that collides with head, rail and front manifold/lifting hardware.
owner_no_disassembly: Engine off/cool: wide view showing pump, heater tube, intake/fuel rail and exhaust-side landmarks.
Accessible front and side views of the same tube, including casting entry and hose/bead end; do not remove components for visibility.
A ruler beside a safely reachable straight portion and in the same depth plane; an unscaled view is still useful for topology.
bench_required: Identified replacement pump/tube: square-on front, side and top views with in-plane scales.
Measure tube OD, entry point relative to shaft axis/rear mounting face, centerline bend stations, hose-end axis and reach, bead and insertion dimensions.
priorities.datum: Pump shaft axis plus rear mounting face and fixed mounting-hole pattern; engine-front direction visible in every view.
priorities.uncertainty: Perspective and hidden depth dominate current projected axial endpoint. A single oblique picture cannot define3D routing; do not infer millimetre accuracy from the existing0.60mm projected agreement.
alternatives: Identified assembled1994 VIN-Y donor engine photos with common landmarks
priorities.exact_fidelity_user_dependency: Owner photos are the minimal route to actual installed routing and modifications; donor images establish only the donor. Hidden dimensions may remain estimated even after photos.

priorities.impact: Build the missing identified temperature sensor and connector interface without guessed probe reach.
owner_no_disassembly: Accessible wide location view and closer connector/hex/visible stamp view, without unplugging or removing sensor.
Record any readable part tag/engineering number; service source says Order By Tag Number.
bench_required: Identified spare F2DZ12A697A or documented MTE5041 comparison: overall length, hex thickness, probe reach from explicit thread gauge plane.
Connector keyed face and two orthogonal sides with terminal pitch/recess, latch and shell dimensions; mating connector identification.
Host port location/axis/gauge plane and internal wall/airflow clearance from an applicable donor manifold or drawing.
priorities.datum: Sensor axis, declared tapered-thread gauge plane and connector key direction; host manifold datums independently surveyed.
priorities.uncertainty: Replacement5041 supports3/8-18NPTF and25mmhex only. Package dimensions are excluded. Torque does not establish axial depth or hex seating.
alternatives: Manufacturer5041 or Walker210-1002 dimensioned drawing with interchange proof
Measured identified spare sensor and donor manifold
priorities.exact_fidelity_user_dependency: Replacement comparison does not identify the truck engineering stamp. Owner-readable tag/photo can resolve identity; hidden installed depth requires later authorized service evidence or remains unknown.

priorities.impact: Replace cartridge placeholder with credible internal physical pieces only after bearing identity is known.
owner_no_disassembly: Existing pump receipt/box label or accessible casting/brand markings; no external photograph reveals bearing rows.
bench_required: Identified applicable spare or retired pump: bearing marking and supplier number, preferably before any destructive section.
Qualified bench survey of outer ringOD/width, shaft steps/axial stations, row types/counts, element/cage construction and bearing end seals.
If no component drawing exists, sectioning or teardown is a separate spare-part task; preserve orientation and record disassembly damage.
priorities.datum: Pump shaft axis and rear mounting face; hub/impeller/coolant-seal axial stations and outer-ring faces.
priorities.uncertainty: No Gates44009/Ford bearing identity established. Generic Schaeffler sizes do not match the inherited envelope and cannot select a production bearing.
alternatives: Manufacturer bearing bill of materials/drawing for an identified pump revision
Retired/donor applicable pump supplied to a bearing specialist
priorities.exact_fidelity_user_dependency: Exact installed internal revision cannot be resolved without supplier traceability or an identified retired original. No request to dismantle the running truck; generic construction must remain labeled if no specimen becomes available.

stop_rule: Do not repeat general catalog/image searches. Resume each CAD task only after its named identity/datum evidence arrives or root explicitly authorizes a bounded illustrative scope.
